title: Coastal Alabama Community College
description: Coastal Alabama Community College demonstrates an extreme disregard for its own security and the security of its students and makes no attempt to address these deficiencies. Therefore, we are publishing their sensitive information, such as student education records, protected health information, financial aid and loan information, employee personnel files, Social Security numbers, and payment card data. They are also known for their incidents, and we are making this information publicly available to you. As a result, they violate laws such as HIPAA, FERPA, GLBA, and PCI DSS.
